name: @examples/tailwind-alpine-theme
description: Reference Alambic theme using the Tailwind + Alpine preset.
//comment: No scripts on purpose. The example stays in the workspace for dependency linking (so `alambic` resolves to the workspace @alambic/cli), but doesn't expose `build` / `dev` scripts — that way `pnpm -r run build` from the monorepo root doesn't try to run them and hit the bin-symlink chicken-and-egg (cli's bin isn't linked until cli is built; the example's build depends on the bin). To run the example, `cd` into this directory and use `pnpm exec alambic <command>` — see README.md.
